methodology.daily: For each (zone, type, day-of-year DOY 1..366), aggregate daily mean MW values from all prior years (excluding current year) whose DOY is within ±7 calendar days of the target DOY (wrap-around at year boundary). Yields ~60 samples per cell for stable percentiles.
methodology.hourly: For each (zone, type, month-of-year 1..12, hour-of-day 1..24), aggregate raw hourly MW values from all prior years (excluding current year). ~120+ samples per cell.
methodology.monthly: For each (zone, type, month-of-year 1..12), aggregate daily mean MW values from all prior years (excluding current year). Used for the Year monthly chart.
methodology.fields_per_cell: mean (€[arithmetic mean]), p50 (median), p5 (5th percentile), p95 (95th percentile), n (sample count)

fields.mean: arithmetic mean of MW values in the window
fields.n: number of samples in the cell
